definition.zh-TW: 從賒銷到收到錢平均要等幾天，用一年的天數除以應收款項週轉率算出。天數越少表示收款越快。
definition.en: The average number of days between a credit sale and its collection, found by dividing the days in a year by receivables turnover. Fewer days mean faster collection.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
